terms.definition: A tube that carries blood around the body.
terms.function: Delivers blood to every part of the body.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the body's delivery network.

terms.definition: A thick-walled vessel carrying blood away from the heart.
terms.whyItMatters: They supply the body's blood at high pressure.

terms.definition: A vessel carrying blood back toward the heart.
terms.function: Returns blood, using valves to stop backflow.
terms.whereItIs: Returning from the body toward the heart.

terms.definition: The tiniest blood vessel, where exchange happens.
terms.function: Lets oxygen, nutrients, and waste pass to and from cells.
terms.whereItIs: Forming fine meshes between arteries and veins.
terms.whyItMatters: This is where the real delivery happens.
